title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 45-48 (Padmodbhava, Padmamukhi, Padmanabhapriya, Rama)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 45 to 48: Padmodbhava, Padmamukhi, Padmanabhapriya, Rama, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 45 to 48 with meaning
caption: Names 45 to 48 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 45 to 48**: **Padmodbhava, Padmamukhi, Padmanabhapriya, Rama**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Padmodbhava, Padmamukhi, Padmanabhapriya, Rama.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Padmodbhava** means **Lotus-born**. At the churning of the ocean of milk she rose standing on a fully bloomed lotus.
**Padmamukhi** means **Lotus-faced**. Her face is serene and cheerful, like a blooming lotus.
**Padmanabhapriya** means **Beloved of Padmanabha**. Padmanabha is Vishnu, from whose navel a lotus arose.
**Rama** means **She who delights**. She who gives delight and joy to the heart.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
